title: The 10th AI City Challenge
abstract: arXiv:2608.17044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The 10th AI City Challenge, held with ECCV 2026, marks a decade of community benchmarking for intelligent transportation, smart cities, and physical AI. Since its 2017 start with vehicle detection, classification, and tracking, the challenge has grown into a broad benchmark suite for multi-camera perception, multimodal reasoning, synthetic-to-real learning, generative forecasting, and privacy-preserving evaluation. The 2026 edition continued this growth with 325 registered teams, up from 245 in 2025, and participation from 26 countries and regions, up from 15. Its six primary tracks cover multi-camera 3D perception, transportation safety captioning and VQA, traffic anomaly reasoning, text-based person anomaly search, generative traffic video forecasting, and cross-city object detection. translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2608.17044v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：第十届AI城市挑战赛与ECCV 2026同期举办，标志着智能交通、智慧城市和物理AI社区基准测试的十年历程。自2017年以车辆检测、分类和跟踪起步以来，该挑战赛已发展成为一个涵盖多摄像头感知、多模态推理、合成到真实学习、生成式预测和隐私保护评估的广泛基准套件。2026年版本延续了这一增长势头，注册团队从2025年的245支增加到325支，参与国家和地区从15个增加到26个。其六个主要赛道涵盖多摄像头3D感知、交通安全字幕生成与视觉问答、交通异常推理、基于文本的人员异常搜索、生成式交通视频预测以及跨城市目标检测。赛道3进一步包括两个域外排行榜，作为赛道7和赛道8提交，用于鱼眼交通违规理解和行人情境分析。
tldr: 第十届AI城市挑战赛（ECCV 2026）作为十年社区基准测试的里程碑，通过六个主要赛道和两个域外排行榜，推动了智能交通与智慧城市中多摄像头感知、多模态推理和生成式预测等关键技术的发展。
en_tdlr: The 10th AI City Challenge (ECCV 2026), marking a decade of community benchmarking, advances intelligent transportation and smart cities through six primary tracks and two out-of-domain leaderboards, driving key technologies in multi-camera perception, multimodal reasoning, and generative forecasting.
